page.title: Cleanup
page.intro: Camera snapshots, timelapses and pictures of other extensions pile up in the server's storage. Each rule says how long things stay in one folder. Nothing in a storage is deleted until you start it on this page, with your own rights. Only printer rules can also run on their own.

due.later: Storage rules do not run on their own yet: Prusa Connect cannot delete in a storage through the extension protocol. Once it can, they will run on a schedule again (see ROADMAP.md).

form.printerActive: active (automatically every {interval}, at most {max} files per run)
form.printerActiveDry: active (automatically every {interval}, at most {max} files per run, dry run for now)
form.printerNote: Never during a print, never the file of the current or last print and never files without a date. Files without a copy count among the newest but are never deleted. By hand, the printer is cleaned with your rights.
form.printerNoteAuto: Never during a print, never the file of the current or last print and never files without a date. Files without a copy count among the newest but are never deleted. By hand, the printer is cleaned with your rights; automatically as the extension, as long as you may operate the printer yourself.
auto.title: Automatic printer run
auto.on: Every {interval}, the active printer rules run, each only while the person who saved it may still operate that printer. At most {max} files per rule and run, only with a copy in Connect Local.
auto.onDry: Every {interval}, the active printer rules run, each only while the person who saved it may still operate that printer. At most {max} files per rule and run, only with a copy in Connect Local. For now as a dry run: nothing is deleted, it is only written to the history.
auto.off: Off. Printer rules can run on their own when printer_auto and auto_interval are set in the extension's settings (see README).
